# moodle-student-mcp

> Free, open source, read only MCP server that lets AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others) read a student's Moodle courses, due dates, grades and announcements. It cannot submit, edit or delete anything.

## Setup
- Needs MOODLE_BASE_URL and MOODLE_TOKEN.
- Copy the Moodle mobile web service key from Preferences, User account, Security keys.
- Run with npx -y moodle-student-mcp. Run `npx moodle-student-mcp doctor` to check the setup.

## Tools (all read only)
- get_my_courses
- get_upcoming_due_dates
- get_overdue
- get_assignments
- get_my_grades
- get_course_grade_items
- get_course_content
- get_announcements

## Links
- Source and README, https://github.com/AnonymousOnyx22/moodle-student-mcp
- Also available, Brightspace MCP for D2L Brightspace, https://brightspacemcp.com
